name: APANA SA node
summary: APANA regional hub sa.apana.org.au / adelaide.apana.org.au; DNS records survive (no service). NOTE: the earlier SA nodes box and lemon merged into SATECH (1995); the later SA hub carried other machines (tierzero, chuckie, pasa).

events.details: APANA SA/Adelaide regional hub (after box/lemon merged to SATECH); Adelaide region linked from apana.org.au homepage by 12 Jul 1997; founding predates the archive and is unverified.
Regional nodes folded into the single National Region.
